_about: SSO string Performance patches: is a slurred note's level fixed by its exact local context, and does a context keep its level shape when transposed? tools/soundlibraries/context_reuse_scan.py (its header has the method and result). Measured 2026-10-13 on the Windows test VM: kthost (offline VST 3 host), Kontakt 8 + SSO, each patch from MuseScore's resaved setup (library defaults), 44.1 kHz. levels: "section|window|embedding|shift|copy" -> take -> the swell levels (perceived loudness, tools/playbackverify/loudness.py, ~dB) of the window's five notes w0 w1 T a1 a2. table: per section and all, abs / shape (level minus the window's median, same phrase), single take / 3-take means, |diff| p50 / p90 per window note and inner (w1 T a1): noise (copy 1 - copy 0), emb (between embeddings; same / other place in the phrase), shift1/2/5 (transposed - original, same embedding); offset: window mean, transposed - original. Measurement only: the renderer does not read this file.
